reviews.title: Solid and comfortable
reviews.comment: Exactly as expected and does everything it says. Feels so comfortable even after coming from an ergonomic K870 Logitech. RGB on gaming keys, programmable beyond reasonable needs, solid and comfortable
reviews.author: LG User
